message.content:
If you want to watch **MSNBC live online for free**, the most legitimate option in these results is a **free trial of YouTube TV**, which includes MSNBC live and lets you cancel anytime.[3] The **MS NOW app** also lets you watch live news and stream MS NOW shows on demand **when signed in with a TV provider**.[7]

A few caveats:
- Some sites claim to offer **free MSNBC live streams** directly, but these are third-party streaming sites rather than official MSNBC/MS NOW services.[1][2][4][6]
- The official app listing says live streaming is available **with a TV provider sign-in**, so it is not fully free for ongoing use.[7]

If you want, I can help you with:
- **Official ways** to watch MSNBC online
- **Free trial options**
- **Device setup** for phone, TV, or browser
